title: Toolchain sanity and WSL shader bridge (MSVC+Windows SDK; WSL DXC)
purpose: Ensure Windows MSVC builds the app; allow WSL to compile HLSL to DXIL and drop into repo.

steps.detail: Document and enforce VS 2022 generator: -G 'Visual Studio 17 2022' -A x64
Verify tools/dxc.exe works; compile shaders during build; copy dxcompiler.dll/dxil.dll next to exe
Add WSL instructions to compile shaders: dxc -T lib_6_3 -Fo .../raytracing_lib.dxil .../raytracing_lib.hlsl
Clarify CLion can drive MSVC via CMake, but cannot use WSL gcc/clang for the app; Windows SDK needed
Confirm PIX installation and recommend using Release build if debug layer causes issues

acceptance: Windows build uses MSVC and runs
WSL dxc can produce .dxil that the Windows build uses
